title: Hypnotherapy, NLP and EMDR
summary: Therapeutic support using hypnotherapy, neuro-linguistic programming (NLP) and eye movement desensitisation and reprocessing (EMDR) techniques.
details:
- Initial chat and getting to know you session - 30- 60 mins.
- A combination of Hypnotherapy, NLP and EMDR  can be used in a session based on  individual needs. Helps with fears, phobias, anger, anxiety, confidence, depression, trauma and other issues that have an impact on daily life.
- Supports  positive changes and emotional regulation, teaches practical strategies to use outside sessions.
- Addresses subconcious patterns to reshape thinking and behaviour.
- Sessions are also available for adults.
